d.why: Jones is Ato Essandoh's D'Bari lieutenant who greets Vuk on Earth and reports that the cosmic force is inside a mutant girl, which sets Vuk's plan against Jean in motion.
Jean's mother speaks in the opening car scene and dies in the crash Jean's powers cause, the buried trauma that drives Jean's whole story in Dark Phoenix.
Frye is the Essex House head orderly who speaks during the Firefist standoff and is one of Russell's abusers; Wade shoots him, which gets Wade and Russell sent to the Ice Box.
Sluggo is a collared Ice Box inmate seen beside Black Tom with no lines, his larger role cut from Deadpool 2.
Alan Tudyk's redneck only chats about toilet paper with his friend when Cable arrives, one short scene that changes nothing.
Cable's daughter is seen silently in brief future glimpses and named through her teddy bear, with no lines of her own.
David Kallaway's Rhodes (the same bit part as the Rhodes entry) has no distinct lines or action of his own in Logan.
Mohawk is a Reaver credited only by his haircut, a description rather than a name, with no part of his own.
Rey is a background heavy among Pierce's men in Logan with no distinct lines or action of his own.
Macon is a background heavy among Pierce's men in Logan with no distinct lines or action of his own.
Jackson is the Canewood enforcer who fights Will Munson over the water, is run off by Logan, and comes back at night with gunmen to threaten the Munsons.
Jackson is one of the Transigen clone children who does nothing apart from the group and has no lines of his own.
David Kallaway's Rhodes is a bit part in Logan with no distinct lines or action of his own.
Dani's father hides her and dies fighting the Demon Bear in the opening, and in the climax vision tells her it was not her fault and to wake up, which lets her take control of the bear.
Sam's father appears only as a Demon Bear illusion in the mine with one line, a short scene that changes nothing.
Mariko's mother is a silent background family member at the Yashida compound with no part.
The Yukon hunter Logan confronts in the bar over the poisoned arrow has a few lines in that one scene, which changes nothing in the plot.
Erik's mother is torn from him at the camp gate and speaks to him before Schmidt shoots her, the murder that unlocks his powers and drives his hunt for Shaw.
Erik's father only struggles silently with the guards at the camp gate, with no lines.
Rogue's mother only looks up from the piano and rushes to her daughter's room in one short scene that changes nothing.
Rogue's father only runs upstairs and shouts for an ambulance in one short scene that changes nothing.
Travis's wife takes in, feeds and clothes the fugitive Logan and is shot by Agent Zero, a killing Logan then avenges.
Phelan is a background logger working beside Logan with no part in the plot.
Marcuse is a background logger working beside Logan with no part in the plot.
Van Mier is a background logger working beside Logan with no part in the plot.
The hospital surgeon is credited only by his job and just says Logan is fine before Stryker pushes him aside.
Cornelius is Stryker's Weapon X scientist who runs the adamantium bonding and calls out Logan's vitals during the procedure that creates Wolverine.
General Kent only watches the Weapon X procedure among the generals, with no lines.
